failures.symptom: Extreme elongation on vowels (e.g., Alif Madda held for over 800ms) causes CTC logits to flatline and output only [PAD] blank tokens. The backtracking decoder slips and jumps to the next available character state prematurely.
failures.remedy: Implement a post-processing trellis smoothing filter or utilize a transition-duration penalty that prevents state transition in the Viterbi solver when logits are dominated by blank tokens during prolonged vowels.

test_case_failures.cause: Acoustic flatline during slow melismatic chanting
Nasal Ghunnah transition blurring boundary markers
